text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса is the victor of the dream
match.
Not only that, she also brought
tons of
excitement to the crowd and
competition as an
incredible entertainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At the award ceremony, Эль Кондор Паса
declares
her intention to make future
races just as exciting
and entertaining as
she takes on the world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса has shown her true
potential as an
entertainer. Cheers and
praise echo endlessly at
the racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
